name: arithenco
expr: code = arithenco(seq, counts); dec = arithdeco(code, counts, length(seq)); rt = isequal(seq, dec); cl = length(code);
comment: MATLAB arithenco / arithdeco: arithmetic coding pair. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on encoded bit string and decoded sequence. Implements the Sayood textbook E1/E2/E3 rescaling algorithm matching MATLAB's source. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship arithenco/arithdeco in core (signal/communications package only); reports N/A.
